input.label: CONTRADICTED
input.reasoning_summary: The claim states that Intel earned net income of more than $3 billion in 2026 through the end of September. Evidence E2 shows a table with financial results for the nine months ended September 26, 2026, which displays a net loss attributable to Intel of $(11,441) million (i.e., -$11.441 billion), not a net income of more than $3 billion. The table shows this as "(24.8)%" margin. This directly contradicts the claim that Intel earned net income of more than $3 billion during this period. Instead, Intel had a substantial net loss of over $11 billion for the nine months ended September 26, 2026.
